matches.rationale: Both identify the same data integrity issue: Table 2's noise robustness numbers were artificially inflated to exaggerate AC-ViT's advantage. The finding explicitly notes the caption states the values were adjusted, exactly matching the ground-truth corruption.

The finding points to the same Section 2.2 paragraph about the backward component, quoting text that reads as an inconsistent external critique. This captures the logical incoherence introduced by mixed notation, unsupported claims, and contradictory statements described in GT2.
No finding mentions the unequal 700 vs 300 training epochs or the resulting unfair performance comparison. The corruption is a protocol issue not covered by any existing finding.

The overgeneralized claim in the Conclusion is not addressed by any finding; the findings cover data integrity and context misalignment but not interpretative distortion of universal performance claims.
Fabricated references in the Related Work section are not mentioned in any finding; the findings discuss tables, figures, and internal inconsistencies, not bibliographic integrity.
The omission of environmental/energy impact discussion for longer training is not identified in any finding; the epoch discrepancy is logged but the ethical omission is not.
The misalignment between the Abstract's 18% forgetting reduction claim and its Section 6 specificity is not captured; no finding addresses abstract-body inconsistency or the forgetting claim.
Promotional language in the Introduction is not flagged by any finding; the findings focus on data manipulation and incoherent text, not rhetorical tone.

Both describe a data integrity violation in Figure 6: the test loss for the Residual Mixer was distorted to falsely improve AC-Mixer's relative performance, exactly as reported in the finding's caption evidence.

Missing hyperparameter details (learning rates, regularization, etc.) in Sections 4 and 5 are not mentioned in any finding; the only finding about missing content refers to placeholder images, not protocol gaps.
The overstated forgetting claim in Section 6 is not covered by any finding; the findings do not discuss continual learning experiments or scope limitations of the 18% improvement.
The Abstract's promotional rhetoric ('remarkable success,' 'superior performance') is not identified as a problem in any finding, which instead target data integrity and context misalignment.
The omission of fairness/bias concerns from the ethical discussion is not mentioned in any finding; the findings do not address ethical integrity omissions related to architectural compression.
Inequitable training budgets (epochs/batch sizes) for baselines are not flagged by any finding; the findings cover data manipulation and internal contradictions, not experimental design inequities.
Overly smooth and fluctuation-free curves in Figures 2 and 3 are not mentioned; the data integrity findings are specific to Table 2 and Figure 6, and placeholder images are a different issue.

The contradiction between the claimed linear backward paths (L-i+1) in Section 2.2 and the heatmap/experimental evidence is not identified by any finding. The finding about Section 2.2 criticizes internal notation and critique insertion, not theory-experiment inconsistency.
